ticket.summary: 7+ year old water heater rumbling/popping on heat cycle, never flushed; no leak, no gas smell, hot water and pressure normal - booked flush & sediment service.
mitigation_advice: No shutoff needed tonight - safe to leave running since there is no leak and no gas smell
If the tank ever starts leaking or overheating: turn the gas control dial to OFF (or switch off the breaker) and close the cold-water inlet valve on top of the tank; do not drain it yourself [PB-04]

quote_lines.description: Water heater flush & sediment service (incl. relief valve/burner check)

ticket.customer_message: Booked! You're all set - Tuesday Sep 1, 10:30 AM at 72 Tanager Way, WH-FLUSH at $139 flat rate, roughly 80 minutes on site. The popping is sediment, not a countdown timer. Only reason to touch it overnight would be if it starts leaking or overheating - then shut the gas dial (or breaker) off and close the cold inlet valve on top of the tank [PB-04]. See you tomorrow!
